headline: Selected Dr. Welch as next Superintendent, subject to contract negotiation, and ratified three-year AFSCME Local 294 union contract.
summary: Members discussed the strengths of all three finalists before voting: Dr. Allen, Mr. Bott and Dr. Welch. Member Manning cast the only no vote on the selection.
decisions: Ratified the three-year AFSCME Local 294 collective bargaining agreement, July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, unanimously.
Selected Dr. Welch as next Superintendent, subject to successful contract negotiation, by a 6-1 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Vice Chair Cornell made a motion to ratify the AFSCME Local 294 Collective Bargaining Agreement successor contract for a term of three years (7/1/2026-6/30/20229). Member Miranda seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Vice Chair Cornell made a motion to select Dr. Welch as the next Superintendent subject to successful negotiation of a contract of employment... Motion passed with 6 votes in favor and 1 against.
